topic: Why supermarkets put milk at the back
title: Why Milk Is Always at the Back
viralAngle: The store is using your walk, not hiding the milk.

scenes.text: Stores hide the milk on purpose.
scenes.visualIntent: Shopper walking toward supermarket dairy refrigerators

scenes.text: You came for one carton | your feet still cross the store.
scenes.visualIntent: Shopper pushing a cart down a long grocery aisle

scenes.text: That walk takes you past snacks, fruit, and deals.
scenes.visualIntent: Grocery shelves of snacks and fruit along an aisle

scenes.text: That extra grab is the point | not an accident.
scenes.visualIntent: Shopper adding a snack to the cart in a grocery aisle

scenes.text: Your walk is the product | not a missing fridge.
scenes.visualIntent: Supermarket dairy milk refrigerators at the back wall
